name: card-swap
title: Card Swap
description: Slanted 3D stack of cards in the corner of a section that deals itself through on a timer.

meta.interaction: Runs on its own — every few seconds the front card drops away, the rest step forward into its place, and the dropped card rises back on at the rear; it can be set to hold still while the pointer rests on the stack, and cards can be clicked.
